notes:
Summary: PolyVox is a mid-market e-commerce CX platform (multi-tenant SaaS) expanding into live multilingual support. Primary goal: reduce agent handle time and improve first-contact resolution via agent-assist + auto-summaries, with automatic locale-aware tone and per-region routing. Key constraints: must meet data residency requirements for EU customers, integrate with existing Zendesk + internal ticketing, and survive marketing-driven traffic spikes (Black Friday style).

POC scope: 2-week Dedicated pool with a small model variant for embeddings + hosted large decoder for agent assist streaming. Evaluate on: 95th-pct latency for streaming responses (<300ms token step target), summary F1 vs human baseline, cost per conversation, and fallback behavior when capacity is saturated.

Security & compliance notes: engineering wants SSO/SAML + audit logs forwarded to Splunk, KMS-managed keys for model payloads, retention controls (90d default, configurable). Legal flagged data residency for EU merchants — propose region routing + Private for EU-only enterprise customers later.

Technical details / asks from their infra lead (quote): "We need guaranteed tail-latency under 150 qps bursts — if you can't keep tokens streaming, we need a graceful degrade to cache-based responses and a clear SLA."

Integrations: Zendesk webhook -> Redwood routing; tool-calling to internal CRM for ticket enrichment (customer metadata, order status); output must include locale tags and a tone score so agent UI can present alternative phrasings.

Next steps / close plan: deliver Dedicated POC by 2026-03-20; side-by-side cost model vs current vendor; security signoff from PolyVox legal by 2026-04-10. Blockers: legal/residency, performance SLO for spikes, final pricing for Dedicated commit.

Stitch notes: shorthand entries exist in thread — see drive doc pricing and security questionnaire. Many fragments on calls: "tone per locale is non-negotiable"; "we can't drop EU data out of region"; "agent throughput matters more than raw quality in peak times."
